nodes.label: Runbook (relaunch + gotchas)
nodes.rationale: How to relaunch the stack on the Chameleon P100 node: systemd rag-app service, Ollama model check, one-time index build, port 8501 security-group note, and the gotchas that cost hours (Ollama pin, stray advisor .env, Docker-baked FEEDBACK_DB_PATH default crashing under systemd).

nodes.label: Ollama <=0.11.x version pin gotcha
nodes.rationale: Ollama 0.32 bundles a CUDA-13 runtime requiring NVIDIA driver >=570; the node has 560, so it silently runs the model on CPU (~2.4 tok/s, GPUs idle). Ollama 0.11.11 ships a CUDA v12 runtime that uses the P100s (~9 tok/s). Pin until the driver is upgraded to 570+.

nodes.label: Stray advisor .env override gotcha
nodes.rationale: The advisor's config loads its own package .env first; a stray ~/chi-edge-advisor/.env on the node overrode the LLM provider/model and forced heuristic-only fallback. The RAG .env is the single source of truth — keep the advisor's deleted and exclude .env when rsyncing.

nodes.label: rag-app systemd service
nodes.rationale: A bare streamlit run launched over SSH dies on session teardown; the systemd unit with Restart=always keeps the app persistent and auto-restarting.
